name: @changfenhuang/dsh-annotation
description: dsh-annotation-zh — DSH Web 选中批注插件的自用改版（基于上游 omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation v1.4.11, MIT）。Self-maintained modified version of the DSH Web selection-annotation plugin: select assistant text, annotate (optional), press Enter to send the annotation block with your message. Not affiliated with the original author.
author: omdsh-dev (original work, MIT) · Niuniu-Sir (modifications)

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run build && node --check lib/index.js && node --check client.js && npm test

upstream.name: dsh-annotation
upstream.note: Unmodified upstream LICENSE is kept in LICENSE; see NOTICE.md for the full attribution and change list. This repo does not track upstream updates.
